name: Engulf
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within medium range.

On a win, until the beginning of your next turn, they cannot attack or cast spells.

On a loss, the same effect occurs, but they may spend a half action or half their movement to end it.

Describe how your restrict their movement.
successes:
✨: Their movement is halved.

🌞: Their movement is reduced to zero.

💀: Remove mana from your mana pool equal to the cost of this spell.
